subject: general
question: The compound interest on a sum of ₹7,500 for 2 years at 4% p.a. is
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹7,500

Rate (R) = 4% p.a.

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = P × (1 + (R)/(100))T - P

**Calculation:**

CI = ₹7,500 × (1 + (4)/(100))² - ₹7,500

⇒ CI = ₹7,500 × (1 + 0.04)² - ₹7,500

⇒ CI = ₹7,500 × (1.04)² - ₹7,500

⇒ CI = ₹7,500 × 1.0816 - ₹7,500

⇒ CI = ₹8,112 - ₹7,500

⇒ CI = ₹612

**The compound interest on a sum of ₹7,500 for 2 years at 4% p.a. is ₹612.**
